verdict.rationale: First-party docs explicitly state that agents support "dynamic variables and overrides for per-conversation customization," which directly matches the story's core of injecting per-caller context at call time. However, the evidence is a single overview-line mention with no detail on how variables are passed or what can be overridden. missing for 10: documentation of the injection mechanism (SDK/API/telephony parameters), scope of overridable fields (prompt, first message, voice, language), how variables are referenced in prompts and tools, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
